_comment: Curated, globally recognizable seed shows per onboarding genre. Hand-picked (the catalog's `votes` column skews to anime/telenovela/Marvel, so a pure top-votes pick is not recognizable). Every title is validated to exist in catalog.parquet with an EXACT title match by tests/test_seeds.py. Most are IMDb-sourced rows with an empty poster_path, so GET /api/seeds resolves their posters via the TMDB fallback (app/poster.py) at request time and caches per genre.
